_comment: Promo codes the lint allows in blog copy (W1.4). Only codes the airport, the lot, or Triply itself publishes AND that checkout accepts (an active promo_codes row). Every entry names its source. Anything else fails the write. TRIPLY10 was listed here on 2026-10-30 but no such row exists in promo_codes and no non-WELCOME code was active then (checked 2026-10-30) - add a code only after its row is created and active. The 23 <IATA>5 codes below are active since 2026-11-07; each is one airport's code, so a post names its own airport's code (bookings.promo_code shows which airport's posts drove the sale). Each entry: { code, source, addedOn, percentOff } or, for a flat-dollar code, { code, source, addedOn, amountOff, minSubtotal } — percentOff is the ONLY savings claim the lint accepts for that code without an outside source. amountOff/minSubtotal are the only $ figures the price check accepts for that code, and only in an edit that names the code.
